narr: Localized flooding occurred in association with a thunderstorm complex over southeast Illinois and the lower Wabash Valley. Numerous showers and thunderstorms occurred on the leading edge of a southwest wind flow of warm and moist air. High pressure over the central Gulf coast states combined with low pressure over the upper Missouri Valley resulted in the southwest wind flow.
ev: Half a foot of water was over the road near Springfield Road and Williams Road, six miles southeast of New Harmony. Half a foot of water was over Highway 66 and Goodman Road, five miles east of New Harmony. Seven miles northeast of Mt. Vernon, a water rescue was conducted on Caborn Road.
